name: Uratanuki
source: Uratanuki is one of the four main characters and love interests in Handsome B☆Y's. He is a member of the light music club, serves as the group's leader, and is voiced by the real-life Uratanuki himself from the utaite unit Urashimasakatasen.
translation: Uratanuki is one of the four main characters and love interests in Handsome B☆Y's. He is a member of the light music club, serves as the group's leader, and is voiced by the real-life Uratanuki himself from the utaite unit Urashimasakatasen.
